mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_wrong_question (user_id, question_id, custom_question_json, subject_code, knowledge_block_id, source_type, wrong_count, master_status, error_reason_tag, user_notes, last_wrong_answer, last_practiced_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{questionId}, #{customQuestionJson}, #{subjectCode}, #{knowledgeBlockId}, #{sourceType}, #{wrongCount}, #{masterStatus}, #{errorReasonTag}, #{userNotes}, #{lastWrongAnswer}, #{lastPracticedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE wrong_count = wrong_count + 1, last_wrong_answer = VALUES(last_wrong_answer), last_practiced_at = VALUES(last_practiced_at), master_status = 'UNMASTERED'
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM user_wrong_question WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
